name: wifi-marketing-platform
description: Enterprise Multi-Vendor WiFi Marketing System (MikroTik, UniFi, Ruijie)

scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared && cd apps/backend && npx prisma generate --schema=prisma/schema.postgres.prisma && npm run build
scripts.build:portal: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/portal
scripts.build:dashboard: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/dashboard
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:portal" "npm run dev:dashboard"
